notes.title: v1.21: Quality-of-Life & Bugfixes patch, available now
notes.content:
Hey everybody! We're back with a quick update for Cattails: Wildwood Story. v1.21 brings with it several quality-of-life changes and bugfixes, as well as a handful of balance changes. Read the full patch notes below, or dive right in by launching the game from your Steam library.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/ebcba230f53a282c393b8918510ea4a8d4efe8f2.png

Patchnotes: v1.21

 Prey, Herbs, and Treasure stockpiles can now be toggled on/off. Select the stockpile name to toggle (turn off to prevent automatic daily resource depletion and perk activation.)
 Once a Buddy reaches the max Buddy Level (10), their daily relational decay is now permanently disabled.
 Disabled daily relational decay on Kitten difficulty
 Greatly reduced daily relational decay value on Easy difficulty (-5/day)
 Slightly increased daily relational decay value on Impawssible difficulty (+1/day)
 Item loss on death penalty rebalanced to be less punishing
 Changed price of Minnows at Ember's shop (38 -> 42 mews)
 Changed price of Peppermint** at Ember's shop (20 -> 26 mews)
 Reduced hit points of Void Beetles (9->7 on Normal difficulty)
 Fixed a rendering bug related to mailbox item attachments when switching between letters
 Addressed an issue related to the "Seedy" and "Green Thumb" achievements not progressing when harvesting certain 3* herbs
 Addressed an issue with the Community Content API related to adding new rival marriage kittens to existing savefiles
 Fixed a collision map issue in East Central


You can view the current version you are running in the lower-left hand corner of the Main Menu or Pause menus. You can force Steam to update your version to the latest (v1.21) by navigating to Library -> right-click Cattails: Wildwood Story in the lefthand pane -> Properties -> Installed Files -> "Verify integrity..."

Also, we wanted to take this opportunity to let you know that we've been hard at work on the Nintendo Switch port of the game, and the release is right around the corner! Cattails: Wildwood Story will release on the Nintendo Switch on November 30, with preorders available now on the eShop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/8e989bd3da974963dddc98f495e3e9f7d42e0be4.png

Until next time!

-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: v1.10 Patchnotes: New NPC, Bugfixes, & More!
notes.content:
Hey Wildwood cats!

We're back with an update for Cattails: Wildwood Story! Today's v1.10 patch includes some awesome new content. Also, a bunch of pesky bugs have been squashed. Let's dive right into it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/b1f915be1d33ff81f32bea4f1684a5f07013b9cd.png

Full Patchnotes: v1.10
-New NPC: Umbra (available to recruit after completing the Main Story)
-New Wedding Venue: Birch Lake
-New Colony Layout: Desert (blank canvas)
-3 new Tasks (Of a Feather, Research Project, Shadow-stone)
-7 new Emblems available for your colony (stars, snake, cozy gradient, acorn, ghost, pumpkin, frost)
-Added additional safeguards against accidental file deletion in file select menu
-Savefile system work to prevent loss of progress in certain edge cases
-When creating a new file and choosing to skip the intro, you will now receive a complimentary 50 XP to train a starting skill of your choosing in place of Lion's Roar
-Added Toad to Alabaster's shop
-Added Amethyst to the Task Board shop
-Improved the overall quality of the Spanish localization
-Addressed a rare issue with mine progression related to puzzle statue spawn locations
-Addressed an accessibility issue related to the double-tap run command
-Addressed an issue with the player character walking instead of running after interacting with certain objects or talking to NPCs when Auto-Run is set to "On"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/90b6bb4240eb22cfbe34a7909e7d413e0b07598b.png

Of particular note is Umbra, the newest member of the Cattails: Wildwood Story cast. Recruit this unique resident after completing the Main Story by visiting the PIllar of the Wildwood. A word of warning, however: this cat won't be easy to recruit! Best of luck to all those who wish to invite Umbra to live in your settlement. 😸

There's also a brand-new colony layout to choose when starting a new savefile! Settle your town in the desert, a sparse and empty region that provides the perfect blank canvas for creating your masterpiece. All essential town services and starting cats' dens are clustered efficiently in the center, allowing full creative control over each of the four quadrants. Also, a quick tip! If you love the idea of the "blank canvas" but don't want to live in a dust bowl, you can change the ground type of your colony from Dirt to anything you like (grass, stone, etc) at the Build Menu. Maybe you want an empty meadow instead? The choice is yours!

We've also added a new wedding venue where you can say "I do" with the cat of your choosing. The Birch Lake provides an idyllic spot at the shores of a small woodland pond.

You'll also find 3 new tasks and 7 new colony emblems available. Speak to Coco and select "Manage colony details" to view or choose one of the new emblems.

Finally, a smattering of bugfixes and balance patches rounds out the update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/1d00a586f2ba7ed6ea72b793937cf14cafbd6362.png

Help, my game isn't updating!
If you are having trouble downloading the new patch, you can force Steam to check for updates by doing the following:
Navigate to Library and find "Cattails: Wildwood Story" in the left-hand pane. Right click it and select Properties -> Installed Files -> "Verify integrity of files". This should start the download!
You can verify that your version is up-to-date on the Main Menu. In the lower-left hand corner it should read "Release v1.10". That means you've got the latest patch!

Thank you all once again for the amazing launch week. We're somehow still sitting at 100% positive reviews which is unbelievable! Alright, the dev team is taking the day for some much-needed rest. We appreciate each and every one of you! ❤️

-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: September Update | Feature-complete! 🤩✨
notes.content:
Hey everybody! We’ve got a big update for you all today, so let’s dive right in and start unpacking all the juicy new details…

September marks the end of the third quarter, which means our Steam release (Q4 2023) is just around the corner! And great news: Cattails: Wildwood Story is now feature-complete!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/fd1549a547d87355d6ca651a63aee1166822f910.gif

What does that mean? That means that every feature promised for launch is now implemented into the game, including all stretch goals! Over the past thirteen months we released regular updates to keep you all informed as we continued development of the project. This morning we put out a game update that is available through Steam to our beta-tier (and higher) backers so they can try out everything prior to our Steam release. Until launch, we’ll continue to iron out any lingering bugs, glitches, and quality of life issues. We’ll also be working with our localization partners on the Spanish and German translations, which are underway and progressing nicely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/d4973478749e87cfe777bd76f75ab523eae7eb23.gif

Let’s talk about some of the awesome new features included in today’s patch!

Main Story

Last month saw the addition of the first steps into the exciting Main Story. Beta players were able to enter the first of the Dark Ruins and take on its many challenges. This month, we’ve completed the three additional Dark Ruins, as well as a special finale sequence with plenty of rewards to cap things off. We don’t want to spoil the story so we won’t say much, but these additions add quite a lot of new content to the game and provide the player with a very interesting choice to make…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/67202cdf1dc4a1daf8cd9e88aaccbd483ae601ab.png

If you play through the entire Main Story prior to launch, we’d love to hear your thoughts! Please consider leaving a comment below with story-related feedback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/7e9e48913d945f97db245cdfa1b82a1e9141b4ca.png

Recruitment Items Status

A new menu was added that can be viewed at any time. This panel will show you the current required items at the Pillar of the Wildwood that must be donated in order to recruit new cats. It will highlight your currently-held items in black so you know which items you have ready to donate and which you’ll need to still find. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/b8f74ab1e09ae5a47d3d4df801376ef7f06cfb74.png

We hope this will help make it easier to keep track of which items you’re looking for! Pause (or open your inventory) and use the left/right arrows at the top of the screen to access this new menu.

Misc.
-Buddies are now smarter about avoiding lava
-An audio cue will play when the player becomes critically low on health (3 hearts or less.)

Demo & Steam Release News
The free demo, which launched on June 1, has been taken down today in preparation for the Steam launch later this year. We will have more to say on that very soon!

We are so excited to be entering the homestretch on this amazing project with all of you. Now that all of the features are implemented, we can’t wait to get the game to all of you soon. Keep your eyes peeled for a release date announcement in the coming weeks… 😻

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/61c3c86076f6c222e62a4129f95f749e1de29cfa.gif

Alright, that wraps things up for September! We’ll be back with another update post soon. Until next time…

-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: August Update! | Beta v0.60 (the Main Story begins!)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and happy August! We have another development update for you all with some exciting new features. Read on for all the details!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/0525084c662f08116623b169f95c50a83fd3f8e5.png

We are well into Q3 2023; that means Q4 (Oct-Dec) is just around the corner, which is when we plan to launch Cattails: Wildwood Story on Steam! At this time we are well on-track for a release later this year. Stay tuned for a more specific launch date, but the announcement shouldn’t be too far away. There’s just a few more features we need to hammer out before we’re ready to launch, including the Main Story (more on that below!) 😸

Demo: Last Chance!
We’ve seen some great engagement with the free demo that started at the beginning of June and received some excellent feedback from those who played it. As we ramp up towards launch, we will be taking the demo down at the end of August. You’ll have this entire month to play it if you haven’t yet had the chance; however, starting in September the demo will no longer be available!

Beta v0.60
A new game update is available now through Steam for our beta-tier backers! Let’s talk about all the changes…

Load Times & Optimization
One of the things we worked very hard on this month was general optimizations, which should make the game run smoother and at a higher framerate; and significantly reduced loading times! On one of our development devices, the initial game load-up time was reduced from 74 seconds down to just 9 seconds 🙀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/d83b95da25b4ce8c5244386024507b42e43aafee.gif

No matter what machine you are playing on, you should see a quicker loading time, especially on macOS devices. We’ve also added a handy loading bar graphic to help visualize progress as the game files are initialized. No more spinning beach-balls or “application is not responding” warnings! Hooray!

The Main Story begins!
Dark dreams have alighted upon the cats of your colony… Warnings and evil tidings from a mysterious source. What could these cryptic messages mean?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/9aec58234fe88095a2b8be52d5e797dc0d7ed855.png

Scattered throughout the Wildwood are Dark Ruins, strange places built eons ago by cats who have been all but forgotten by time. To ensure your colony is safe, you will need to enter each and disperse the darkness within. Gather your wits, because several of these dangerous places are filled with puzzles, traps, and enemies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/2335f6d1d0957ab4169107a151f1c1b8b2d6616f.png

In Beta v0.60, you can enter the first of these four Dark Ruins and tackle its many challenges. What answers lie within to the riddles that plague your colony?

For both new and existing savefiles, you can begin the Main Story after you’ve visited the Temple at least once and sleep in your den on Spring 3 or later. The Main Story currently pauses after the first Dark Ruins has been purified, but rest assured that the other Dark Ruins and their challenges are coming soon…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/e4613dcecdc8da9f2c2ab7513163996666c04b1c.png

We are so excited to hear your thoughts on the beginning of the Main Story! It has been in the works since early 2020 and we’ve put a lot of thought into the art, music, and narrative to bring it to this point. Each of the Dark Ruins will reveal a bit more about the truth behind the Wildwood and we can’t wait for you all to discover it.

That’s all for August! We’ll be back in September with another development update. Let us know your thoughts and we’ll talk to you again then! Until next time,

-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: July Dev Update! Beta v0.50: Events, expanded Rival Marriages, & more
notes.content:
Hey everybody! I know we’re a couple days early but the July update is ready so here we are with the monthly development report!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/fa329c99c8ad60abeebae9d1561d7079f1047ee6.png

We were thrilled to take part in Steam Next Fest during the month of June, a celebration of upcoming games with free demos. The Cattails: Wildwood Story demo launched June 1 in preparation for the event and is still live for anyone who wants to try it out. We’ll keep the demo up at least until the end of July.

We loved our time showcasing Cattails: Wildwood Story to players on Steam! We got so much great feedback and saw some excellent new traffic to the game’s Steam page. Here’s a couple interesting stats!

-22,500 users have downloaded the demo!
-The median playtime for the demo is over an hour (that’s super good for a demo! 😸)
-Cattails: Wildwood Story is currently ranked #558 out of all upcoming Steam games in terms of wishlists 🙀 (roughly 30 games release every day on Steam so this is really, really awesome to see)

Beta v0.50
We’ve also rolled out a game update to our beta-tier backers! Please note that these new features are not available in the demo.

New Accessibility Features
Two new hotly-requested items were added to the in-game accessibility options menu: Auto-run and Alternative Text!

Auto-run: Turn this feature ON and your cat will always run automatically, without needing to hit the run key. (Default: OFF)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/516719c41430740d65ce550e0c5408948643fea1.png

Alternative Text: Turn this feature ON and all in-game text will be replaced with a simple sans-serif font alternative. We’re partial to the stylish hand-drawn font featured in the game by default, but we understand there are plenty of great reasons to want a cleaner, more legible option. We’ve selected Roboto Condensed - Regular as the alternative font as it generally fits the existing character of our custom font face. (Default: OFF)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/f234093ad08bfca46dc5d85017c2e3295e955657.png

We’ve also patched up a couple typos, made a few bugfixes, and added a “Sell Everything” button to shops that allow you to sell your items.

Rival Marriages - New Dialog, Mail, & Events

Last month we introduced the Rival Marriages feature to the game. This month we fleshed out some additional details that will make each Rival Marriage even more rewarding to complete.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/7dc4a7daf583520a8f3e3bcdc9cc3a65543a3842.png

-New Dialog: Unique dialog was added to each rival marriage spouse, including lines about their kitten(s) after they are born.
-Mail: You’ll receive a thank-you note from each rival marriage couple after you’ve helped them get together.
-Events: We’ll talk more in depth about Events below, but each rival marriage couple now has 3 special Events that must be witnessed before they will pair up!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/282e01d870802ce1a2cd7ef79a40affc2c4fedd1.png

Events

This is the biggest new feature in Beta v0.50! Events are special cutscenes that play when certain criteria are met. During Events, we have a chance to show the NPCs that live in your colony in a fun new way with scripted dialog and interactions with other NPCs. Some Events require your participation, and there may even be consequences for your choices, so pay attention!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/39dc75291db85bf7fa6644f91360187e139b265a.png

We’ve added 30 Events to the game in Beta v0.50. We also know that some players may not wish to experience the interruption brought about by Events (especially during replays or speed runs!) so we’ve included a feature that allows you to bypass any event. Simply pause the game during an event and select “Skip Event” to instantly continue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/60c429b8d39225461a5d34aacda975d12739e309.png

We trust that players who choose to watch Events when they occur will enjoy this new feature. Events have given us a great chance to showcase NPC interactions between each other (not just with the player) and really dig into the quirks and personality traits that make each character unique and fun to be around. You can really learn a lot about your neighbors by watching Events unfold!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/8aee08bd2e9ffa0a5782780ce9c35e6e776550d4.png

Ok, that wraps up the developer update for this month! Looking to the future, we have a few months of development to go still with the impending addition of the Main Story. We’ll have more to say in a future post. Until next time!

-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: ✨ Demo Available Now! 🐈 + Beta v0.40
notes.content:
Hello everybody! It’s time once again for the monthly development update!
And wow, what a month it has been! I can’t wait to dive into all the details. BUT FIRST, a major announcement!!

The free public demo for Cattails: Wildwood Story is AVAILABLE NOW on Steam!!!! 😻🙀😻

We have been working so hard on bringing the demo to life! This is the first chance that anyone and everyone can play a sample of the game for themselves. Just open up the Steam page, hit download, and you can play through the entire first season of Spring! Wow!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/3ec8c15eaf34a1c319ac4cbda53ae233c57c44d7.png

We can’t wait to hear all about everyone’s experiences with the demo. Let us know if you’re planning to try it out! You can download the demo right now on Steam!

[previewyoutube=3CfvOboYIvk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Beta v0.40
And that’s not all! We’ve also got a new version, Beta v0.40, available now for our Kickstarter beta-tier backers. Please note that this update is only for beta-tier backers. Sorry demo players! 
Let’s talk about what’s included!

Rival Marriages
By far the most exciting new feature in beta v0.40 is the Rival Marriages system! Certain cat residents may get to know each other very well and pair up as a couple.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/137d36f5206ab3c6a03695e435c104777331de3a.png

There are certain predetermined NPC pairings. Once you’ve befriended both NPCs of a potential couple and treated them very well, one of them may approach you and ask for a bit of relationship advice. You can either encourage them to get with their specified partner, in which case they will soon get married and move in together, or discourage them from pursuing a relationship, in which case they will listen to your advice and remain single.

We’ve done things this way to ensure that you, the player, aren’t “locked out” from dating or marrying a cat that you really want to date by factors outside of your control. However, please note that if a rival marriage couple does end up together, they will remain together and at that point will not be available to romance in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/222f28711dbf586d76437ae5b66eec7bb992d3e0.png

There are 5 rival marriage pairings. We don’t want to spoil who ends up with who, but we’re happy with how it all came together and can’t wait to hear what you think!

Rival Marriage Kittens! 🐈
Yes, that’s right! Rival marriage couples can eventually have their own little kittens that will become a part of your colony!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/a302b1c458a767a19538c57776260175a91130fd.png

Between the 5 rival marriage pairings, there are 8 new kittens that can be born! We’ve once again worked with the talented Narabas Artworks on bringing these kitten portraits to life. Here’s a very limited sneak-peak at the cute new portraits 😻

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/b283328ba8ed2ed98d6afc9b05170a2a1af2deb5.png

Of course, you can talk to, befriend, and buddy up with these new kittens as well. They add so much life to town with their energy!

At the moment, Rival Marriage couples may seem to get together rather abruptly. With everything going on (demo launch + other publishing tasks,) we were able to implement the Rival Marriages system, but not the other planned system which will support it: Events. These character events will allow us to inject some much-needed personality and pacing into the lives of the residents of your colony, and we plan to use them to make the build-up to a rival marriage proposal much smoother. Stay tuned for more on Events in future updates.

A Note on New Game+ and Rival Marriages:
We’ve made the decision to reset all relationships to their default values when a New Game+ file is created. That includes Rival Marriage pairings. In practice, this means that when you start up a fresh New Game+ savefile, you’ll find any previously-paired Rival Marriage couples will no longer be together, and any kittens they may have had together will be gone from town. But don’t worry! You can work to bring them together again, just like you’ll be working to re-befriend the cats around town. By doing things this way, you won’t be locked out of dating and/or marrying these cats in your New Game+ savefiles.

Wild Red Roses
A minor tweak, but one that was requested by a few of our players, is that we’ve added a spawn location for Red Roses to the Old Farm map region (upper-left hand corner of the map.) Each day 1 Red Rose will spawn here, so you can get started dating a cat of your choosing quicker if you’d like (before Ember starts carrying Red Roses at their shop.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/80b9f404dfaf24ef85f38971a2e77127540af064.png

Localization Underway!
Lastly, we wanted to update you all on the status of our German & Spanish localizations!

Our localization partners are currently working very hard on bringing these translations to life, but localization is a very time-consuming process. We’ve done a lot of work behind the scenes this month to get the game ready for localization, but we’re only at the start of the journey.

A fun story: When we started development of Cattails: Wildwood Story, we sat down and did some quick-and-dirty napkin math, coming up with the conclusion that at the end of development the game would probably have around ~100,000 English words. That’s approximately the length of an average novel (!!!)

HOWEVER, what we didn’t consider was all the stretch goals, character dialog updates, and extra fun stuff that we’ve added along the way! When we crunched the numbers, we quickly found out the reality of the situation… The game is already approaching 200,000 words!! 🙀 Twice our original estimate!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/d01372724efd682227724312c93a1bd0fc15ca06.png
(Imagine this, but waaaay more text! These are the kind of files we’re working with as we localize the game.)

We’re really happy with both the quantity and the quality of the text as-is, but all those extra words require a lot of extra work & time from the localization team! Long story short, things are happening on the localization front, but work will be proceeding at a slow-and-steady pace for the foreseeable future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/d4973478749e87cfe777bd76f75ab523eae7eb23.gif

Okay, that about wraps things up for the June update! Please remember to wishlist us if you haven’t already, and feel free to try out the demo if you’d like to see what the game plays like ahead of the full launch on Steam later this year.

Until next time!

-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: May Update! Beta v0.30: Expanded Mines, New Game+, & More
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to the May developer update for Cattails: Wildwood Story! Another amazing month of development is behind us, and we’re excited to release yet another test build for our beta-tier backers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/ec02bfc8c35fe02d370fba30fe36b6e9897cb031.png

Exciting News Coming Soon!

While we can’t give the details just yet, we wanted you all to be the first to know that we’ve got some very big news for everybody coming later this month! Not an official release date just yet, but I’m sure several of you will find it interesting 😻 We’ll have more to say in a couple of weeks, so watch your email inboxes and our social medias @CattailsGame and stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/9e697670e57dec9a0e5c36d267b040fb9e18dee0.png

Beta v0.30

A new version, v0.30, is now available on Steam for our early access backers. There’s several exciting new features, in addition to the usual bug fixes and balance changes.

Expanded Mines

If you enjoy your time in the mines, this update is for you! We’ve added not just one, but two new mines to complete, chock-full with new items, new enemies, new challenges, new floor types, and new rewards. When you reach level 100 of the first mine, you’ll find the key to the second mine. Likewise, at the bottom of the second mine you’ll find the key that unlocks the third mine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/f6dfa46dfaf7be31d97719a7315f9198e54a3f5a.png

Each of the three mines gets progressively harder and harder, so make sure you come prepared! (Especially once you reach the third mine, that one can be quite tricky 😹)

Mines Two & Three feature new generation algorithms and lots of new items to unearth. In Mine Two, be on the lookout for Alexandrite, a precious gem that is extremely rare. In Mine Three you’ll be searching the depths for Brightstone, a mythical stone with powerful properties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/5533d7c221569292b86437b9f10586490a7d940f.png

Halting your progress are a host of new enemies with their own unique attack patterns. Take on Tremortroves, diabolical machines that generate harmful shockwaves; swarming Prowlers in their fragile nests; creepy Lurkers that cloak their presence and strike from the shadows; and plenty more intriguing foes.

You’ll also find new staircase modifiers! You may encounter a Candle challenge that requires you to extinguish many small lights in order to progress, or be greeted with false staircases in an Illusion challenge. Some rocks are placed directly over toxic poison vents, so watch for the telltale signs before you go rampaging through every boulder you see!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/683d7117960751bbf12977c0ac8b9ab9b62cf04d.png

There’s also four new floor types to learn about before you go spelunking. For example, on Beach-type floors, you’ll find a veritable invasion of Granite Crabs that nestle beneath the rocks. Fortunately for you they are slow and lumbering, but you may find yourself easily beset by several of these minions trailing you in a long line. Try not to get cornered!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/545dcc63978b7cb1c2a0d008e6e67f2ba0ac1081.png

Of course, there’s plenty of new rewards for the brave cats who choose to take on these deadly trials. Each mine has two Power Paws to collect, which means that every Power Paw is now officially available in-game! Hooray!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/54455f39af259af8f2b16aa8e876bfce0b1a5a9f.png

The moles Molu and Molay will also open new Mole Cash stores when their respective mines become available, and each store has loads of cool stuff to purchase. From new pets to special items to crafting recipes, there’s lots of neat prizes available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/70a18d214edb91a84ac26075238d520e2f4cae0f.png

Craft Supply Troves to greatly increase your colony’s stockpile values; make Dynamite to provide you with a powerful way to progress in the caves; create Farsighted Orbs to magically discern the direction to the nearest downward staircase; or construct Bright Emblems out of fabled Brightstone gems to greatly secure your colony’s claim over the wilderness.

New Game+

Start a new savefile and begin with several bonuses! New Game+ is available for any player with at least 1 kitten that has reached buddy level 10 (the max level.) In the future, New Game+ will probably also require that you’ve completed the Main Story, but since the Main Story isn’t implemented just yet, that is not currently a requirement :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/522b01bc9d23f8c550fa63decb5e167149d57a8c.png

Visit the New Game+ Portal in the Temple to get started. You’ll pick a kitten to bring over to the new savefile. You’ll begin with their coat color, appearance, and accessories. Your old savefile will remain as-is and be unaffected by the creation of your New Game+ savefile.

When you first load up your New Game+ savefile, you will also be granted a pool of XP, Mews, Items, and Skills based on you and your kitten’s lives up to that point. In general, the longer you’ve played on the original file and the more you’ve accomplished, the bigger your starting bonuses will be in the New Game+ savefile.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/2c73957762941e993249764a58d070f4e589eb1f.png

You’ll also carry over your progress in the following areas:
-All unlocked NPCs
-All discovered Power Paws
-Colony/Den layouts
-All unlocked furniture
-All unlocked accessories

However, everything else will be reset in the New Game+ savefile! You’ll be able to once again tackle most challenges from the beginning, including:
-Relationships/dating/marriage
-Map influence
-Stockpiles/construction projects
-The mines
-Museum
-Most achievements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/7f4b3721a3bb074c96025c94e9f19ba047425d64.png

We hope this New Game+ feature will allow players who want to maximize their time with the game plenty of additional time to explore the world of Cattails: Wildwood Story and take on its many challenges in a fresh new way.

Name Randomizer:
Ever get stuck trying to think up the perfect name? By popular request, we’ve added a Random button to the name inputs on the character creation and kitten creation panels!

Disable Achievements:
Some of our players have asked for an option to disable achievement progress & notifications, so we’ve added that option in the in-game Accessibility menu.

Alright, that’s everything for the month of May! Stay tuned for that exciting news coming later this month (we can’t wait to say more about it!!) Until then,

-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: April Update! | Beta v0.20: Recruiting Cats, Museum of Curiosities, Achievements
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to the April developer update for Cattails: Wildwood Story! New features are now available for our Beta players, bringing the game closer to its launch state. Let’s get right into it!

Beta v0.20

Another month, another slew of new features and changes! In addition to the regular bug fixes and balance tweaks, here’s some of the exciting new mechanics:

Museum of Curiosities
Glimmer’s Museum of Curiosities is now open! Find Unidentified Curios in various places as you play (in interesting areas, in the mines, even in certain shops). Bring them to the Curio Identification Table in the Museum to discover what they are, then consider donating the identified Curios to the Museum by speaking to Glimmer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/910ebac5a487e4679537d9d11892b6ac9315e059.png

There are 30 Curios to discover, and Glimmer will be more than happy to tell you all about each and every one of them when they are donated. Of course, there are plenty of rewards available for those who donate lots of Curios to the Museum. There’s even a Rainbow Power Paw up for grabs for the generous few who complete the Museum!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/2627486ce39af43eb35639cbfbb2a0cb083e33a6.png

Achievements

Completionists, take note! Achievements are now available in Cattails: Wildwood Story. There’s currently a whopping 55 achievements to unlock!

View your progress in the all-new Achievements menu. You’ll also be rewarded with in-game XP when completing each achievement’s requirements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/439125df5190dfa14776255bfc167542a7376a0e.png

If (for whatever reason) you’d like to clear your Steam account of all Cattails: Wildwood Story achievements, allowing you to start fresh, you can enter this special promo code in the pause menu: AGAINAGAIN (this will reset your global Steam achievement progress for Cattails: Wildwood Story, locking each achievement, but not your in-game achievement progress on a per-savefile basis.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/3299c467c29d1e3998563d1cc6b93a58acd50ef9.png

For existing savefiles created prior to Beta v0.20, you’ll find that many Achievements that you’ve already met the requirements for will unlock automatically when you load your existing file; however, some achievements track stats that we previously were not tracking, so these achievements will begin at 0% progress. However, all achievements should now be able to be unlocked on all files, regardless of when they were created.

The Gift Record
The Gift Record is a nice new quality-of-life feature!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/f223049efd401524c0f98a990bf16aaafd735f53.png

Each NPC has their own Gift Record that will begin completely empty. When you give a gift to a particular NPC, if that gift is a Liked or Loved item, it will be added to that NPC’s Gift Record. View an NPCs Gift Record via the Social Panel by selecting their name to see which previously gifted items were received positively by that NPC. Use this knowledge to ease the burden of making new friends!

Recruiting Cats (new savefiles only)

This one is pretty big! We’ve been planning this for a long time and we’re so happy with how it turned out. New players (and new savefiles) will have a much smoother introduction to all of the many, many characters in the game now through the Pillar of the Wildwood.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/16cfc2b467f0141ff7a890ac204df958737df429.png

When you start your file, you’ll have several cats already in your colony: Ember, Spark, Coco, Elli, Jag, and Krampy. However, the other possible residents must now be recruited before they will join up. You’ll find the new Pillar of the Wildwood in the central chamber of the Temple of the Forest Guardian. This powerful object can locate cats that live nearby and help you to meet their unique needs so that they will move into your town.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/a3bd974f7ec2d209e47e03881cad846b781d4aad.gif

Each possible cat that you can recruit is represented by a Card that lists their bonuses and benefits, as well as their needs. You’ll have to collect the required items and donate them at the Pillar of the Wildwood, at which point they will immediately join your colony and you’ll be instructed to place their den via the Build Menu. The first few cats should be fairly easy and straightforward to recruit, so you can begin to expand your town’s population quickly.

Important note: Savefiles created in Beta v0.10 or earlier will automatically have all residents recruited for compatibility reasons. Your savefiles will continue to work as usual, but this new feature is for new savefiles only.

Balance Update
Players seeking a challenge will find that Hard mode is a bit harder than it used to be, and Impawssible mode is quite a lot more punishing than it once was. All other difficulty settings (Kitten, Easy, Normal) remain unchanged.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/76e491f4341b64871480260d6b5fede38a1bad1a.png

Phew, another month down and another major update released! We’re narrowing in on the last few big features that need to be added to the game prior to launch. We’ll continue to keep you updated as development progresses. Check back in May when we’ll have more info for you here. Until then,

-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: Beta Launch + State of the Game | Kittens, New Intro, & More!
notes.content:
Welcome back to another monthly update for Cattails: Wildwood Story!

It’s finally here! The month of March marks a very important milestone for the project. Right on target, we’ve officially launched the closed beta! If you backed to receive beta access (and did not already have access to the alpha phase,) you will find your download keys and instructions in your Kickstarter account inbox. 😸

We’ll be using this update to provide you with two important types of news. First, we’ll talk about the changes and new features that are now available in Beta v0.10 (Kittens! New intro! And more…) Then, we’ll talk more broadly about the road ahead for Cattails: Wildwood Story in the “State of the Game” section. We’ll wrap up with information about our upcoming livestream tomorrow (more on that in a bit!)

[previewyoutube=ukc5ktxbaAQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Beta v0.10
An incredible amount of work has gone into polishing the game for our new incoming wave of beta players, introducing new features that will be of interest to both our existing players and those who will be starting a new file. Alpha players, you’ll be happy to hear that all savefiles from the alpha will be fully compatible with the beta.

New Introductory Experience
Perhaps the most noticeable change is the new introduction! When creating your very first file, you’ll be ushered into a dramatic intro that will introduce you to several major characters, teach you how to play, and offer some exciting choices that will impact the starting state of your colony. We hope this new introductory experience will help you get a better feel for the world of Cattails: Wildwood Story as it sets the stage for your adventures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/66eed4eea37c047684c61fca0141c2817eb6ccc6.png

Players who have already created a save file will be given the choice of whether or not to play the new intro, or skip it, during character creation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/51b9eeb3dee4da8845cc6afabfa1f28cfa1b9ad7.png

Kittens! 🐈🐈🐈🐈
At long last, kittens have been added to the game! We know this is one of the most highly anticipated features and we are so excited to announce that players can now have a litter of their very own.

After marrying a cat of your choosing, you may eventually be asked by your spouse if you would like to start a family. You may choose to say yes, no, or maybe someday. If you say yes, the two of you will one day give birth to kittens!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/16e9886d9825e0ff6e825d5d3faf80b7c67d17b4.png

Each of your kittens will have a unique dialog portrait and a special generated coat color that is based on the patterns of you and your spouse. We spent a lot of time perfecting the inheritance system so that it is capable of producing plenty of amazing, cute kittens that will be wholly unique to your playthrough.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/4949fdade7125a528d09158cd97c68e438848229.png

In Cattails 1, each kitten could inherit 1 of 12 possible patterns based on you and your spouse; in Cattails: Wildwood Story, the possibilities are virtually endless! Your kittens will also inherit your body types and eye colors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/5a574004ba602dd999b77269a0bb9e79f48fe3ae.png

Another fun feature we’ve added to the game is the ability to dress up your kittens with accessories! Any non-pet accessory that you have unlocked can be equipped to any of your four kittens at any time. There’s nothing sweeter than a kitten in a costume!

Of course, once they are old enough you can take your kittens with you on your adventures via the Buddy System! While each kitten starts with an Active Trait and a Passive Trait based on their personalities, you also have the option to Retrain your kittens traits and set them to any choice you’d like at the cost of some XP.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/4deed8c36c5604e6075b4ee1f3a42bc367a8268f.png

We believe that the combination of these features will make having kittens in Cattails: Wildwood Story very rewarding as nearly every kitten in every playthrough will be one-of-a-kind.

After having kittens, you’ll also be automatically granted a copy of each of your kittens’ unique coat colors in your Coat Studio so you can wear or share their patterns.

New World Map!
Another feature that we’ve added with the beta is this beautiful new world map illustration by Narabas Artworks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/5a8949fe6bc8ddff87760b8d5d2c131351ef1a7d.png

We couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. Not only is the artwork itself gorgeous, but the map is well researched and very useful for navigation as it is a great representation of the actual in-game world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/dca7ea2984f42ba357cea0dbcf7f1e975998f794.png

Here is an example of the new world map in-game with all the usual information overlaid. Quite an improvement from the alpha version!

State of the Game
Behind us now are the Pre-Alpha and Alpha stages of development. Now we’ve entered the Beta, which signifies that most major features are implemented at this point and the game is finally starting to shape up into a fun, cohesive experience. However, there’s still some time before the full release on Steam later this year, so I wanted to use this chance to give you all an update on which features have been implemented and which are still to come.

Base Game
Implemented:
-Hunting
-Combat, Influence System
-Friendship & NPC Schedules
-Dating & Marriage, Marriage Ceremonies
-Colony Layouts & the Build Menu
-Colony Stockpiles & Construction Projects
-Tasks
-Gardening
-Crafting
-Festivals
-Mining
-Coat Studio
-Kittens
-Buddy System
-Den Decorating & Furniture
-Complete Open World
-Skills
-2+ Hour Soundtrack
-Community Content API
-Tutorial + Intro

To Do:
-Achievements
-Recruit Cats to Colony (instead of every cat being available from the start)
-Main Story
-German + Spanish localization

Stretch Goals
Implemented:
-New Resident 1 (Rosemary)
-New Resident 2 (Zephyr)
-Wedding Venues

To Do:
-Museum of Curiosities
-New Game+
-Rival Marriages
-Expanded Mines

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/6fd0845adb6fbe6cfdb0457468a6a9fe88906db8.png

And here’s a reminder of our current planned release schedule for the full game. We’ll announce official release dates as we get closer.

-Q4 2023: Full Release of Cattails: Wildwood Story on Steam for Windows & Mac!
-Late 2024: Full Release of Cattails: Wildwood Story on Nintendo Switch™

At this time we feel confident in our ability to deliver the full release on time, as we have hit each and every deadline up to this point and have lots of time to finish up the core features of the game before the end of this calendar year. Hooray!

Dev Livestream #5
Lastly, we wanted to remind you that Developer Livestream #5 is taking place on our YouTube channel tomorrow, March 2 at 6pm Eastern Time! We’ll be playing Beta v0.10 to showcase some of the newest features and answering questions from chat. The livestream will run for approximately 1 hour and will be archived on our channel for those who want to watch it later. We’d love to see you there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/2462d389a8f555d136e74002b534cd1ed1f5f653.png

Before we wrap up the monthly update, I just wanted to give a quick shoutout to all of our amazing alpha players for their help in tracking down bugs and submitting feedback during the closed alpha test phase of the project. Thanks to you all Cattails: Wildwood Story is in a much better state than it ever could have been without your assistance. Your passion and commitment to the game inspires me daily and I’m so grateful to have such an awesome community behind the game. 😻

If you can’t find your closed beta access keys and you are entitled to receive them, please reach out either via Kickstarter direct message or to tyler@cattailsgame.com and I’ll help get you sorted.

Alright, that’s everything for March! I’ll be back in April with yet another monthly update. Until then,
-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: February Developer Update!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to the February developer update for Cattails: Wildwood Story! We’ll be talking all about the new features that are included in Alpha v1.00, available now on Steam for our alpha-tier backers.

Beta News!
Before we dive right into it, we wanted to give everyone who’s waiting on the Beta of the game a quick update! We’re right on track and can now confirm that the Beta of the game will become available on March 1 for our beta-tier backers. Hooray! 🎉


Alpha v1.00
Another busy month is behind us and great progress has been made on the game! Here’s a quick look at the exciting new features.

The Buddy System
Take your friends with you on your adventures! Once you reach 3-star friendship status with a cat a new option will appear called “Buddy Up?” Selecting this dialog option will reveal the cat’s Buddy stats (XP and level,) as well as their unique combination of Traits.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/4fd50c986c24285c8cba3369ed727b075e295536.png

Traits come in two flavors: Passive and Active. They provide special benefits to you or your colonymates while you are adventuring with a particular buddy. For example, the “Lucky” trait makes it easier to find rare items; the “Inspiring” trait will give an attack damage boost to all nearby fighters from your colony; and the “Renowned” trait will allow you to gain a small amount of Influence in whatever region you hang around over time. Traits also become more powerful as your Buddy levels up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/276879f7c49e493266df424fb675f2372cb2cbca.png

Your Buddy will help you hunt, fight, and gather herbs. As they do so, they will gain Buddy XP. Once your Buddy has acquired enough Buddy XP they can level up and become stronger! Buddies can continue to be advanced to Level 10, the maximum Buddy Level.

Starting in Year 2, Ember will begin selling Training Manuals at their shop. Use a Training Manual to instantly grant Buddy XP to whoever you’re currently adventuring with.

Wedding Ceremonies
February is the month of romance, so what better time to introduce the most romantic event in the game– your Wedding!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/09bf39850103279c500e1ec5545c5be24633210a.png

Once you propose to the cat of your dreams, you’ll be prompted to select a Wedding Venue. There’s four lovely venues to pick from– The Temple, the Festival Plaza, the Beach, and the Meadow. Choose one and you’ll be whisked away to the ceremony, where all of your friends and family will join you to watch the wedding.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/7dab96673ed6e22e2b2c5d7c9e1f1589f853cd46.png

One of my favorite details of the wedding ceremony is all the little flower bouquets that you’ll find decorating the venue. The colors of the flowers will change based on the base coat color of you and your chosen spouse.

After the ceremony, remember to stick around for a bit and chat with all the attendees!

Expanded Map
14 new map regions are now available to explore! We’ve added a few interesting new biomes– a rugged mountain, a flowery meadow, and an overrun farm. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/c14b43a41e4a9952e399d5d9aceae9ead068964f.png

Of course there’s plenty of secret Power Paws hidden within these mysterious new areas, so be sure to search them thoroughly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/173120f1f7727b03d91e5171e2ad42b31c668e17.png

Tunnel Construction Projects
Now that the map is so big it can be a challenge getting around! We’ve added 4 new Construction Projects that you can view from your colony stockpiles– Tunnel: Northwest, Tunnel: Northeast, Tunnel: Southwest, and Tunnel: Southeast.

Once you construct these projects you’ll be able to place tunnel entrances anywhere in your town via the Build Menu. Use the tunnel entrances to instantly warp far away to regions near the corners of the map. This will make adventuring in the far reaches of the world much more accessible!

Invasions!
A new optional combat challenge has been added to the game– Invasions! These difficult combat encounters will cause enemy Voidlings to spawn in increasingly difficult waves and require you to come very well prepared if you wish to come out alive. If you complete the challenge you will be richly rewarded!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/ee4c7973d82d2410fb974e8c1de27efee048dd43.png

To start an invasion you’ll first need to craft a Wretched Talisman, a dark amulet that can call to the powers of the void. Use the Mole Forge to get started crafting your first Wretched Talisman.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/05a370a5758634bb2f768e01a0d3a15ee520b4d0.png

Use your Wretched Talisman when you are ready to begin the Invasion. An Invasion can be started pretty much anywhere in the world, including your own colony town. If you leave the area while an Invasion is active it will immediately end and your challenge will be forfeit.

Greedy Paw Accessory
Lastly, we’ve added a useful new accessory called the Greedy Paw! You can purchase this accessory from Molo in the mines. While it is equipped, all nearby items will be magnetically drawn into you and automatically picked up into your inventory if you have space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/45bf6786d87aea773523355a106d618d153e3a42.png

You can upgrade the range of your Greedy Paw accessory from the Mole Forge.

Dev Livestream #5!
Ok, that’s all the new features in v1.00! We’re also excited to announce another Developer Livestream to celebrate the launch of the beta in March.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/2462d389a8f555d136e74002b534cd1ed1f5f653.png

Join us on March 2 @ 6pm Eastern Time over on our YouTube channel @CattailsGame for Developer Livestream #5! We’ll be playing the Beta version of the game, showcasing new features, and answering questions in chat about Wildwood Story.

That’s all for this month! We’ll be back in March with another update. Until then,
-Tyler (@FalconDevelops)

notes.title: Happy New Year! 🎊 2022 in Review, Alpha v0.99, & What’s Ahead
notes.content:
Welcome to the January update for Cattails: Wildwood Story!

Happy New Year! 2023 promises to be a major year for Cattails: Wildwood Story because the Steam launch is scheduled for Q4 of this year. We're happy to report that we are still on schedule and excited to jump into another full year of new features, new content, and new surprises for Cattails: Wildwood Story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/ac690fd7a76d98ca6287eaadebec1363930a764b.png

This update is going to be a big one! First, we'll talk about the changes introduced in v0.99, the latest update available now on Steam for our alpha-tier backers. Then, we'll recap 2022 and everything that happened in this monumental year. Lastly, we'll take a look at the future and talk about what's coming next for Cattails: Wildwood Story.

Alpha v0.99 - Now Available

We’ve spent the past month working on a hefty new update with loads of new features!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/83ebb1bec3187df60767dd7a4036c0cd3dc813a0.png

The Influence System

Lead your colony to greatness by securing the lands around your town from the corrupted forces of darkness that lurk within the Wildwood. Send out squads to capture new territory or defend your lands while collecting powerful resources to aid the cats of your colony. Use your gathered resources to construct improvements for the betterment of all.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/a7a6a3bfa5e72a654637121dc541ce21ed6767b4.png

The world map of Cattails: Wildwood Story is divided into square chunks called regions. Each region has an Influence value ranging from 0-100% representing your colony’s claim on that area. You can capture a region by increasing your Influence there to 100%. But beware! If you lose Influence in an area you own and reach 50% or lower, the Wildwood will reclaim the region for itself. Influence can be gained in several ways, such as winning daily battles, assigning squads to attack a region, defeating Voidling enemies, or even just by spending time passing through, hunting, and gathering in a region.

Owning a region is advantageous in several ways: Enemies will be less likely to spawn there, making it safer to travel through, and the land will become more bountiful in the absence of corruption, meaning more herbs, prey, and bugs can be found in a region that your colony controls. Additionally, once you own a region, you can begin to collect its resources into your colony’s stockpiles by sending a squad of cats out to defend that area.

Assigning Squads

Speak with Talon to assign squads that can either attack enemy territory or defend your own lands. Sending a squad to attack will force a Daily Battle to spawn at that location; sending a squad to defend will prevent you from losing Influence in that region for that day and also allow you to gather that region’s resources into your colony stockpiles. At the end of the day all squads will return home and must be reassigned.

Colony Stockpiles

Your colony now has a number of stockpiles for various resources: Prey, Herbs, Treasure, Wood, Stone, and Sand. While you start with each stockpile at a value of 0, you can optionally choose to fill up these stockpiles to unlock special boons that will help you as you play. You can add to a stockpile’s value in one of two ways: by sending squads to defend a region you own, thereby also collecting that region’s resources, or by directly donating your personal items that you find around the world from your inventory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/fe322c4140068adc6cf14c316ab02bfd525b9a5d.png

-Prey: A well-fed colony is a happy colony. The prey stockpile depletes at a rate of 3 units per day. When this happens, you will gain a bonus to all friendship point gains for the rest of the day.
-Herbs: Powerful herbs are useful for keeping cats in good health. The herbs stockpile depletes at a rate of 3 per day. When this happens, all fighting cats that appear from your colony will spawn with extra health until the end of the day.
-Treasure: A wealthy society can focus less on survival and more on self-improvement. The treasure stockpile depletes at a rate of 2 per day. When this happens, you and all other cats in your colony will gain a bonus +1 point of XP every time XP is gained until the end of the day.
-Wood, Stone,& Sand: These stockpiles represent industrial resources used in construction projects. They do not deplete over time and are instead spent to build improvements.

Visit the Founder’s Stone or speak with Talon to view your colony stockpiles.

Construction Projects

Once you’ve funded your colony stockpiles with lots of resources you can spend them on construction projects, one-time purchases that provide a permanent benefit to your colony. Here are a few examples of construction projects:

-Barracks Upgrade (I/II/III): Allows you to assign 1 additional squad per day.
-Improved Roofing: Sleeping in your den grants additional healing and XP.
-Hunting Compendium: Legendary prey will be more likely to spawn in your colony’s owned regions.
-Cultivation: Herbs that grow in your colony’s owned regions will be much more likely to be rank ★★.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/2ce162ff55e6a2a85387b298b2e0ad293ffb4aa4.png

Map Expansion

We’ve greatly increased the size of the world map to better allow players to experience the Influence system! 14 new regions are now available to explore with plenty of surprises hiding within.

New Skills

8 new Skills can now be trained at the Scratching Post in your den. Botany, Diplomacy, Hunter’s Gamble, Kindly Purr, Lion’s Roar, Spectral Dodge, Sweet Melody, and Warding Scrawl may all now be learned, upgraded, and used to your advantage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41845411/cf85fbc5797cb3a5c1e75fda3b0e3118cd32d3d9.png

New Furniture

22 furniture items have been added to the game! Check at Ember’s shop, the festival shop, and Molo’s shop to find these fun new pieces of decor.

New Tasks

14 tasks have been added, bringing the count up to 64 total tasks.

Quality-of-Life

Plenty of bugfixes and balance changes have been implemented in v0.99. Additionally, we spent some time adding a couple small quality-of-life features to the game:
-Tabulated menu: Cattails: Wildwood Story is a game with a lot of menus. It’s easy to forget how to access some of the more obscure menu screens, so we’ve added a new feature that should help out. Most major menus are now unified by a tab switcher that will appear at the top of the screen. Use this new tab switcher to quickly access your inventory, task log, the map, pause menu, collections, and more.
-Furniture catalog filter: Search for specific furniture items with the new filter textfield.
-Crafting: You can now see the description of all output items without needing the necessary ingredients and prerequisites on hand. Simply hover over the “(?) Info” button next to the desired output and a tooltip will appear.

2022 was a massive year for Cattails: Wildwood Story. The game has come such a long way since the start of the year and we're very happy with the progress we've made over the last 12 months. Here's a quick bullet-point summary of some of the highlights:

2023 - Onward towards launch!

Last year was a big year, but this year is going to be even bigger! We’ve got 12 months of hard work ahead to bring the game from its current state (alpha v0.99) to full release. We’re continually energized and inspired by the passion this community has shown for our silly little cat game and we promise to put all our heart and soul into bringing you the game that you all deserve. ❤️

We’ll continue to provide monthly updates to keep you all in the loop on the latest development happenings as Cattails: Wildwood Story advances.

We’re definitely optimistic about our current plan to release the beta in March 2023. Around that time we’ll email all of our beta-tier backers and grant them access to the game, so you can look forward to that!
